subject: R studio package "check" deleted package tree

messages.author: d9a9840f25ec94ec
messages.subject: R studio package "check" deleted package tree
parts:
I am creating a package for the first time, trying to follow Hadley Wickham's workflow (http://r-pkgs.had.co.nz/intro.html), using devtools. I am working on a mac, with Rstudio 0.98.1062 & R 3.1.1.

On clicking the "check" button in Rstudio, the check exited with an error ("* checking examples ... ERROR" : the function example only had a placeholder without any code yet)

At this point I discovered that all of the files in the main package directory where I was working had disappeared, including the Rstudio project file that defined my session.

There is a new folder called packagename.Rcheck. While this does have a package_src subdirectory, which contains some of the source material, it this does not contain all of the material from my original folder (e.g. data-raw/, pkgname.Rproj, .Rbuildignore etc).  This folder also contained my .git repository, which has similarly disappeared.  The only thing that remains is .Rproj.user/

Have I done something to precipitate this?

Is there any hope of recovery (I can't see any...)?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: R studio package "check" deleted package tree

Hi James,

What version of devtools are you using? I think we had a bug that did
that, but it was quite a long time ago.

I'm very sorry about this :( You might be able to use a mac undelete
tool to recover, otherwise you'll have to rely on backups.

Hadley
